'''Girov Dza'tey's second-in-command''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who served as chief lieutenant to [[Girov Dza'tey]] on an expedition to [[Malrev IV]]. When Dza'tey seized control of the [[Sith Temple (Malrev IV)|Sith Temple]] there, the second-in-command distrusted Dza'tey's motives and concern for the crew of the ''[[Starfaring]]'', on which they had arrived, and threw his support behind [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], which defeated Dza'tey.
